# openwrt_ipkg_package (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt package via LuCI /rpc/ipkg.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name as known to opkg, e.g. 'luci-mod-rpc'.

### Optional

- `autoremove` (Boolean) Remove packages that were installed automatically to satisfy dependencies.
- `force_remove` (Boolean) Remove package and all dependencies.
- `update` (Boolean) Update package lists before installing.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID, equal to package name.
